description: An older man in a campaign-style hat and olive field jacket with a medal on his chest leans on a cane and looks to the left. Two or three men in caps and coats stand at the left and right edges. Behind them a sprawling camp of shacks and tents sits on a flat by a river, with smoke rising and a small fire burning. A white domed building with classical wings sits across the water under a dark, stormy sky. No visible text, no frame; the painting fills the image edge to edge.
